div.div:
Notation
◆── composition: the whole owns its parts (User ◆── Space, Space ◆── FileEntry, ...)
◇── aggregation: shared part, independent lifetime (not used in the domain model)
──▷ generalization: TextPreview / ImagePreview are kinds of FilePreview
─── association with multiplicities (1, 0..1, 0..*) and role names
- - ▷ dependency: «use», «reads», «creates» — the source needs the target
Conceptual classes without a direct counterpart in the implementation: Space (ownership is the
FileEntry.ownerId column), Session (the session is a stateless JWT, so no row is stored),
LocalFolder (the bound folder is a path in the desktop settings), FileContent (an object in MinIO
reached through StorageService) and FileEntry.isNewerThan() (inlined in computeSyncPlan).
User.register() / User.authenticate() are realised by AuthService and UsersService.
Enumerations carry the literal values of the TypeScript union types (packages/shared/src/types.ts).
